{{nihongo|'''Sunomata Hachiman Shrine'''|八幡神社 (大垣市墨俣町)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Hachiman Shrine''' (はちまんじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Ōgaki|Q384926|qid=Q384926}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}} (formerly {{ill|Sunomata, Gifu|Q7640962|qid=Q7640962}}, {{ill|Anpachi District, Gifu|Q1204320|qid=Q1204320}}). It stands along the {{ill|Minoji|Q3315566|qid=Q3315566}}. It is also called Nishimachi Hachiman Shrine.

It is one of the candidate shrines for Arakata Shrine (Arakata Myōjin), a Shikinaisha in Anpachi District of {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}. The other candidate shrine is {{ill|Shirahige Shrine (Q11580504)|Q11580504|qid=Q11580504|lt=Shirahige Shrine}}.

Its original location was north of the current site (the riverbed of the {{ill|Sai River (Gifu)|Q7399814|qid=Q7399814|lt=Sai River}}), and is said to have been on the border of {{ill|Motosu District, Gifu|Q1204331|qid=Q1204331}} and Anpachi District.

=== Enshrined deity ===
*{{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}
**According to {{ill|Oguri Hangan|Q11462010|qid=Q11462010|lt=Sekkyō-bushi Oguri}}, {{ill|Oguri Hangan|Q11462010|qid=Q11462010}} is enshrined as a {{ill|Arahitogami|Q521834|qid=Q521834}}.

=== Transportation ===
*15 minutes on foot from "Sunomata" bus stop on the Gikaki Line of {{ill|Meihan Kintetsu Bus|Q11415818|qid=Q11415818}}
**From platform 2 at {{ill|Ōgaki Station bus terminal|Q11433817|qid=Q11433817}} (south of {{ill|Ōgaki Station|Q871579|qid=Q871579}}), bound for "{{ill|Gifu Shotoku Gakuen University|Q5560125|qid=Q5560125}}" or "Gifu Ryūtsū Center South Entrance"
*15 minutes on foot from "Sunomata" bus stop on the Obusa-Sunomata Line of {{ill|Gifu Bus|Q5560101|qid=Q5560101|lt=Gifu Bus}}
**From platform 6 at {{ill|JR Gifu Station Bus Terminal|Q11226229|qid=Q11226229}} (north of {{ill|Gifu Station|Q1144885|qid=Q1144885}}), bound for "W65 Sunomata"
**From platform 1 at {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu stop|Q11415771|qid=Q11415771}} (west of {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Station|Q1109902|qid=Q1109902}}), bound for "W65 Sunomata"
